name: ToxicIgnition / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A muffled gas-cloud ignition whump, a rapid rough orange flame roll and a brief hollow dusty spore flutter. Short poisonous gas fire, heavier muffled onset than pure thermal.
